title: Generating ASTs with recursive
description: Hypothesis builds recursive AST generators using st.recursive with base for leaves and extend for composite nodes, capped by max_leaves.

steps.description: AST generator using Hypothesis recursive strategy.
Imports: hypothesis given and strategies, plus your own AST node classes.
Leaves: one_of strategy combining small integers mapped to Num and variable names mapped to Var.
Recursive step: builds BinOp with operator and two child expressions from kids strategy.
Size limit: max_leaves=25 caps tree size to keep tests fast.
